title: 第二章 开门
content_zh:
天微微亮，尚未鸡鸣，陈平安就已经起床，单薄的被褥，实在留不住热气，而且陈平安在烧瓷学徒的时候，也养成了早起晚睡的习惯。陈平安院子，转头看到一个纤弱身影，弯着腰，双手拎着一木桶水，正用肩膀顶开自家院门，正是宋集薪的婢女，她应该是刚从杏花巷那边的铁锁井打水回来。
陈平安收回视线，穿街过巷，一路小跑向小镇东面，泥瓶巷在小镇西边，最东边的城门，有个人负责小镇商旅进出和夜禁巡防，平时也收取、转交一些从外边寄回来的家书，陈平安接下来要做的事情，就是把那些信送给小镇百姓，酬劳是一封信一枚铜钱，这还是他好不容易求来的挣钱门路，陈平安已经跟那边约好，在二月二龙抬头之后，就开始接手这摊子买卖。
用宋集薪的话说就是天生穷苦命，哪怕有福气进了家门，他陈平安也兜不住留不下。宋集薪经常说一些晦涩难懂的话语，约莫是从书籍上搬来的内容，陈平安总是听不太懂，例如前两天念叨什么料峭春寒冻杀少年，陈平安就完全不明白，至于每年熬过了冬天，入春之后有段时日反而更冷，少年倒是亲身体会，宋集薪说那就叫倒春寒，跟沙场上的回马枪一样厉害，所以很多人会死在这些个鬼门关上。
小镇并无城墙环绕，毕竟别说流寇匪徒，就是小偷毛贼都少有，所以名义上是城门，其实就是一排东倒西歪的老旧栅栏，马马虎虎有那么个让行人车辆通过的地方，就算是这座小镇的脸面了。
陈平安小跑路过杏花巷的时候，看到不少妇人孩子聚在铁锁井旁，水井轱辘一直在吱呀作响。
再绕过一条街，陈平安就听到不远处传来一阵熟悉的读书声，那里有座乡塾，是小镇几个大户人家合伙凑钱开的，教书先生是外乡人，陈平安小的时候，经常跑去躲在窗外，偷偷蹲着，竖起耳朵。那位先生虽然教书的时候极为严苛，但是对陈平安这些“蹭读书蹭蒙学”的孩子，也不呵斥拦阻，后来陈平安去了小镇外的一座龙窑做学徒，就再没有去过学塾。
再往前，陈平安路过一座石牌坊，由于牌坊楼修建有十二根石柱，当地人喜欢把它称为螃蟹牌坊，这座牌坊的真实名字，宋集薪和刘羡阳的说法很不一样，宋集薪信誓旦旦说在一本叫地方县志的老书上，称这里为大学士坊，是皇帝老爷的御赐牌坊，为了纪念历史上一位大官的文治武功。与陈平安一般土包子的刘羡阳，则说这就是螃蟹坊，咱们都喊了几百年了，没理由叫什么狗屁不通的大学士坊。刘羡阳还问宋集薪一个问题，“大学士的官帽子到底有多大，是不是比铁锁井的井口还大”，问得宋集薪满脸涨红。
此时陈平安绕着十二脚牌坊跑了一圈，每一面都有四个大字，字体古怪，显得各不相同，分别是“当仁不让”，“希言自然”，“莫向外求”和“气冲斗牛”。听宋集薪说，除了某四个字，其余三处匾额石刻，都曾被涂抹、篡改过。陈平安对这些懵懵懂懂，从未深思，当然，就算少年想要刨根问底，也是徒劳，他连宋集薪经常挂在嘴边的地方县志，到底是什么书都不知道。
过了牌坊没多远，很快就看到一棵枝繁叶茂的老槐树，树底下，有一根不知被谁挪来此地的树干，略作劈砍后，首尾两端下边，垫着两块青石板，这截大树便被当做了简易的长凳。每年夏天的时候，小镇百姓都喜欢在这边乘凉，家境富裕的人家，长辈还会从水井里捞出一篮子的冰镇瓜果，孩子们吃饱喝足，就拉帮结派，在树荫下嬉戏打闹。
陈平安习惯了上山下水，跑到栅栏门口附近，在那座孤零零的黄泥房门口停下，心不跳气不喘。
小镇外人来往得不多，照理说，如今官窑烧制这棵摇钱树都倒了，就更加不会有新面孔。姚老头在世的时候，曾经有次喝高了，就跟陈平安和刘羡阳这些徒弟说，咱们做的是天底下独一份的官窑生意，是给皇帝陛下和皇后娘娘的御用瓷器，其他老百姓哪怕再有钱，哪怕当的官再大，胆敢沾碰，那可都是要被砍头的。那天的姚老头，精神气格外不一样。
今天陈平安望向栅栏外，却发现好些人在等着开城门，不下七八人之多，男女老少，都有。
而且都是陌生人，小镇当地百姓的进进出出，无论是去烧瓷还是做庄稼活，都很少走东门，理由很简单，小镇东门的道路延伸出去，没有什么龙窑和田地。
此时陈平安和那些外乡人，双方隔着一道木栅栏，两两相望。
那一刻，穿着自编草鞋的少年，只是有些羡慕那些人身上的厚实衣衫，肯定很暖和，能抗冻。
门外那些人，明显分作好几拨，并不是一伙人，但都望向门内的清瘦少年，大多脸色漠然，偶有一两人，视线早已越过少年的身影，望向小镇更远处。
陈平安有些奇怪，难道这些人还不知道朝廷已经封禁了所有龙窑？还是说他们正因为知道真相，所以觉得有机可乘？
有个头戴古怪高冠的年轻人，身材修长，腰间悬有一块绿色玉佩，他似乎等得不耐烦了，独自走出人群，就想要去推开本就无锁的栅栏大门，只是在他手指就要触碰到木门的时候，他突然猛然停下，缓缓收回手，双手负后，笑眯眯望向门内的草鞋少年，也不说话，就是笑。
陈平安的眼角余光，无意间发现年轻人身后的那些人，好像有人失望，有人玩味，有人皱眉，有人讥讽，情绪微妙，各不相同。
就在此时，一个头发乱糟糟的中年汉子猛然早就来催命叫魂，你赶着投胎去见你死鬼爹娘啊？！”

陈平安翻了个白眼，对这些尖酸刻薄的言语，少年并不以为意，一来生活在这座总共没几本书籍的乡野地方，如果被人骂几句就恼火，干脆找口水井跳下去得了，省心省事。二来这个看门的中年光棍，本身就是个经常被小镇百姓取笑打趣的对象，尤其是那些胆大泼辣的妇人，别说嘴上骂他，动手打他的都有不少。加上这人还极其喜欢跟穿开裆裤的小孩吹牛，比如什么老子当年在城门口，好一场厮杀，打得五六个大汉满地找牙，满地都是血，城门前整条两丈宽的道路，就跟下雨天的泥泞道路差不多！
对陈平安没好气说道：“你那点破烂事，等会儿再说。”
小镇没谁把这个家伙当回事。
但是外乡人能不能进入小镇，男人却掌握着生杀大权。
他一边走向木栅栏门，一边伸手掏着裤裆。
这个背对着陈平安的男人，
陈平安很早就让出道路，八个人大致分作五批，走向小镇，除了那个头戴高冠、腰悬绿佩的年轻人，还先后走过两个七八岁的孩子，男孩穿着一件颜色喜庆的红色袍子，女孩长得粉粉嫩嫩，跟上好瓷器似的。
男孩比陈平安要矮大半个脑袋，孩子跟他擦身而过的时候，张了张嘴，虽然并没有发出声响，但是有明显的口型，应该是说了两个字，充满了挑衅。
牵着男孩的中年妇人，轻轻咳嗽了一下，孩子这才稍稍收敛。
妇人男孩身后的小女孩，被一位满头霜雪的魁梧老人牵着，她转头对着陈平安说了一大串话，不忘对身前同龄人男孩指指点点。
陈平安根本听不懂女孩在说什么，不过猜得出，她是在告状。
魁梧老人斜瞥了一眼草鞋少年。
只是被人有意无意看了一眼，陈平安纯粹下意识地后退了一步。
如鼠见猫。
看到这一幕后，原本叽叽喳喳像只小黄雀的小女孩，顿时没了煽风点火的兴致，转过头不再多看陈平安一眼，好像再多看一眼就会脏了她的眼睛。
少年陈平安的确没见过世面，但不等于看不懂脸色。
等到这行人远去，看门的汉子笑问道：“想不想知道他们说了什么？”
陈平安点头道：“想啊。”
中年光棍乐了，笑嘻嘻道：“夸你长得好看呢，全是好话。”
陈平安扯了扯嘴角，心想你当我傻啊？

汉子看破少年心思，笑得更加开心，“你要是不傻，老子能让你来送信？”
陈平安没敢反驳，生怕惹恼了这家伙，即将到手的铜钱就要飞走了。
汉子转过头，望向那些人，伸手揉着胡里拉碴的下巴，低声啧啧道：“刚才那婆娘，两条腿能夹死人啊。”
陈平安犹豫了一下，好奇问道：“那位夫人练过武？”
汉子愕然，低头看着少年，一本正经道：“你小子，是真傻。”
少年一头雾水。
他让陈平安等着，大踏步走向屋子，回来的时候，手里多了一摞信封，不厚不薄，约莫十来份，汉子递给陈平安后，问道：“傻人有傻福，好人有好报。你信不信？”
陈平安一手拿信，一手摊开手掌，眨了眨眼睛，“说好了一封信一文钱的。”
汉子恼羞成怒，将事先准备好的五枚铜钱，狠狠拍在少年手心后，大手一挥，豪气干云道：“剩下五文钱，先欠着！”
content_en:
The sky was slightly bright, and Chen Pingan had already gotten up before the rooster crow. The thin bedding could not trap the heat, and Chen Pingan also developed the habit of getting up early and going to bed late when he was a porcelain apprentice. In Chen Ping'an's yard, he turned around and saw a slender figure, bent over, holding a bucket of water in both hands, and pushing open the door of his courtyard with his shoulders. It was Song Jixin's maid. She should have just returned from fetching water from the iron lock well on Xinghua Lane.
Chen Ping'an withdrew his gaze, walked through the streets and alleys, and trotted all the way to the east of the town. Mud Bottle Alley was in the west of the town. At the easternmost city gate, there was a person responsible for the entry and exit of business travelers and night patrols in the town. He also usually collected and handed over some letters sent home from outside. Chen Ping'an accepted the The next thing to do is to deliver those letters to the people in the town. The reward is one copper coin per letter. This is the way to make money that he finally found. Chen Ping'an has made an appointment there to take over the business of this stall after the second dragon rises in February.
In Song Jixin's words, he was born poor. Even if he was lucky enough to enter the family, Chen Pingan would not be able to keep him. Song Jixin often said some obscure words, which were probably copied from books, but Chen Pingan could not always understand them. For example, two days ago, he talked about the cold spring cold killing young people. Chen Pingan did not understand it at all. As for surviving the winter every year, it would become colder for a period of time after spring. The boy experienced it personally. Song Jixin said that it was called spring cold, and it was as powerful as a carbine on the battlefield, so many people would die in these ghost gates.
The town is not surrounded by a city wall. After all, there are very few thieves and bandits, let alone bandits. Therefore, it is a city gate in name, but in fact it is just a row of old and rickety fences. The fact that there is only a place for pedestrians and vehicles to pass through is the face of this town.
When Chen Ping'an trotted past Xinghua Lane, he saw many women and children gathered near the iron lock well, and the water well's windlass kept squeaking.
After walking around another street, Chen Pingan heard the familiar sound of reading not far away. There was a rural school there, which was jointly opened by several wealthy families in the town. The teacher was a foreigner. When Chen Pingan was young, he often ran to hide outside the window, squatting secretly and pricking his ears. Although that gentleman was extremely strict when teaching, he did not scold or stop children like Chen Pingan who "wanted to study and learn". Later, Chen Pingan went to be an apprentice in a dragon kiln outside the town and never went to a school again.
Further on, Chen Ping'an passed by a stone archway. Because the archway was built with twelve stone pillars, the locals liked to call it the Crab Archway. Song Jixin and Liu Xianyang's version of the real name of this archway were very different. Song Jixin swore that in an old book called the local county annals, it was called the Great Scholar's Archway, which was an imperial gift archway from the emperor, in order to commemorate the cultural and martial arts of a high official in history. Liu Xianyang, a country bumpkin like Chen Pingan, said that this is Crab Fang. We have been calling it Crab Fang for hundreds of years, so there is no reason to call it some nonsense like Da Shi Fang. Liu Xianyang also asked Song Jixin a question, "How big is the official hat of a bachelor? Is it bigger than the mouth of an iron lock well?" Song Jixin's face turned red.
At this time, Chen Ping'an ran around the twelve-legged archway. There were four big characters on each side. The fonts were weird and looked different. They were "do your duty", "hope to be natural", "don't ask outsiders" and "fight in anger". I heard from Song Jixin that except for certain four characters, the other three stone carvings on the plaque had been daubed or tampered with. Chen Ping'an was ignorant about these and never thought about it deeply. Of course, even if the young man wanted to get to the bottom of it, it would be in vain. He didn't even know what the local county chronicles that Song Jixin often talked about were.
Not far after passing the archway, I soon saw an old locust tree with lush branches. Under the tree, there was a trunk that was moved here by someone unknown. After a little chopping, it was removed from both ends.There were two bluestone slabs on the side, and this section of the tree was used as a simple bench. Every summer, people in the town like to enjoy the cool here. For wealthy families, the elders will fish out a basket of ice-cold fruits from the well. After the children have eaten and drank enough, they form gangs and play in the shade of the trees.
Chen Ping'an was used to going up mountains and rivers. He ran to the gate of the fence and stopped at the door of the lonely yellow mud house, his heart not beating and he was out of breath.
There are not many people from outside the town, and logically speaking, now that the money tree of official kiln firing has fallen, there will be no new faces. When Old Man Yao was still alive, he once got drunk and told his apprentices, Chen Ping'an and Liu Xianyang, that what we were doing was the only official kiln business in the world, and it was royal porcelain for His Majesty the Emperor and the Empress. No matter how rich or powerful other people were, if they dared to touch it, they would all be beheaded. Old Man Yao's spirit that day was particularly different.
Today, Chen Ping'an looked outside the fence and found many people waiting to open the city gate. There were no less than seven or eight people, including men, women, old and young.
And they are all strangers. When local people come in and out of the town, whether they are going to make porcelain or do farm work, they rarely go through the east gate. The reason is very simple. The road from the east gate of the town extends out, and there are no dragon kilns and fields.
At this time, Chen Ping'an and the foreigners looked at each other across a wooden fence.
At that moment, the boy wearing self-made straw sandals was just a little envious of the thick clothes on those people. They must be very warm and can resist the cold.
The people outside the door were obviously divided into several groups, not one group, but they all looked at the thin young man inside the door. Most of them had indifferent expressions. Occasionally, there were one or two people who had already looked beyond the young man's figure and looked farther into the town.
Chen Ping'an was a little surprised. Didn't these people know that the imperial court had banned all dragon kilns? Or do they think they have an opportunity just because they know the truth?
There was a young man wearing a strange high crown, with a slender figure and a green jade pendant hanging from his waist. He seemed to be impatient with waiting. He walked out of the crowd alone and wanted to push open the unlocked gate. But just when his fingers were about to touch the wooden door, he suddenly stopped suddenly, slowly retracted his hand, put his hands behind his back, and looked at the straw-shoe boy inside the door with a smile. He didn't say anything, just smiled.
From the corner of his eye, Chen Pingan accidentally noticed that the people behind the young man seemed to be disappointed, playful, frowning, and sarcastic, with subtle and different emotions.
At this moment, a middle-aged man with messy hair suddenly came to call for help. Are you rushing to be reincarnated to see your damn parents? ! "
Chen Ping'an rolled his eyes. The young man didn't take these harsh words seriously. Living in this rural place with few books, if he got annoyed if he was scolded a few times, he could just find a well and jump into it, which would save worry and trouble. Secondly, this middle-aged bachelor who is the gatekeeper is himself a frequent target of ridicule and ridicule by the people in the town, especially those bold and aggressive women. Not to mention scolding him, there are many who beat him. In addition, this man also likes to brag to children wearing crotchless pants. For example, I had a great fight at the city gate, beating five or six big men until their teeth were stained, and the ground was covered with blood. The entire two-foot-wide road in front of the city gate was almost like a muddy road on a rainy day!
He said angrily to Chen Ping'an: "We'll talk about your crap later. "
No one in the town takes this guy seriously.
But whether outsiders can enter the town, men hold the power of life and death.
As he walked toward the wooden gate, he reached for his crotch.
This man with his back to Chen Pingan,
Chen Pingan gave up the road very early, and the eight people were roughly divided into five groups and walked toward the town. In addition to the young man wearing a high crown and a green pendant hanging around his waist, he also passed by two seven or eight-year-old children. The boy was wearing a uniform.Wearing a festive red robe, the girl looks as pink and tender as fine porcelain.
The boy was half a head shorter than Chen Pingan. When the boy passed by him, he opened his mouth. Although he did not make any sound, there was an obvious mouth shape. He should have said two words, full of provocation.
The middle-aged woman holding the boy coughed slightly, and the child calmed down a little.
The little girl behind the woman and boy was being held by a burly old man with a frosty head. She turned to Chen Pingan and said a lot of words, not forgetting to point at the boy in front of her of the same age.
Chen Ping'an couldn't understand what the girl was saying at all, but he guessed that she was complaining.
The burly old man glanced sideways at the straw-shoe boy.
Just being glanced at intentionally or unintentionally, Chen Pingan took a step back purely subconsciously.
Like a mouse seeing a cat.
After seeing this scene, the little girl who was chattering like a little oriole suddenly lost interest in fanning the flames. She turned her head and stopped looking at Chen Pingan, as if one more look would dirty her eyes.
The young Chen Ping'an has indeed never seen the world, but that doesn't mean he can't read faces.
After the group of people had gone away, the man watching the door smiled and asked, "Do you want to know what they said?"
Chen Pingan nodded and said, "I think so."
The middle-aged bachelor was happy and said with a smile: "I complimented you on your good looks. They are all good words."
Chen Ping'an twitched his lips, thinking, do you think I'm stupid?
The man saw through the young man's thoughts and smiled even more happily, "If you weren't stupid, could I let you deliver the message?"
Chen Ping'an didn't dare to refute, for fear of offending this guy and the copper coins he was about to receive would fly away.
The man turned his head, looked at those people, stretched out his hand to rub Hu Li's bruised chin, and whispered: "That woman just now, her legs can pinch someone to death."
Chen Pingan hesitated for a moment and asked curiously: "That lady has practiced martial arts?"
The man was stunned, looked down at the young man, and said seriously: "You kid, you are really stupid."
The young man was confused.
He asked Chen Pingan to wait, and strode towards the house. When he came back, he had a pile of envelopes in his hand. They were not thick or thin, about ten copies. After handing them to Chen Pingan, the man asked: "Foolish people are blessed with stupid things, and good people are rewarded. Do you believe it or not?"
Chen Ping'an held the letter in one hand and opened his palm in the other, blinking, "We agreed that a letter would cost one penny."
The man was so angry that he slapped the five copper coins he had prepared in advance on the young man's palm. He waved his hand and said boldly: "I owe you the remaining five cents first!"
